slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

standing up straight

set three alarms a day and fix your posture every time one goes off. after a month your body holds itself differently, and your mind quietly follows it there.

the slow first word

when it's your turn to speak in a group, wait one breath before your first word. starting slowly tells everyone in the room that you're not afraid of the silence.

learning to breathe

practise slow breathing for 5 minutes before anything stressful: in for 4, out for 6. a calm body makes a calm voice, and a calm voice sounds confident.

morning curiosity

spend 5 minutes every morning learning one new thing: a myth, a planet, a famous invention. starting the day curious instead of anxious changes how you show up everywhere.

sit back in your chair, uncross your arms and rest your hands on the table. taking up a normal amount of space is something confident people never even think about.
